objective: Gate 5C post-audit formal READ_ONLY. Verificar estado real de health y adopcion del ledger despues del cableado de codigo. No asumir ejecucion de jobs. Confirmar integridad de CodigoSync, duplicados de IdempotencyKey y ausencia de cambios estructurales. Solo HRLectura, sin secretos, sin DDL/DML, Production prohibida.

queries.name: gate5c_post_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() original_login

queries.name: gate5c_post_health_adoption
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) total_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN UltimaPruebaUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_test_utc,SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoExitoUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_success_utc,SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoErrorUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_error_utc,SUM(CASE WHEN FechaActualizacionUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_updated_utc FROM dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado

queries.name: gate5c_post_health_status
queries.sql: SELECT EstadoConexion,COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado GROUP BY EstadoConexion ORDER BY EstadoConexion

queries.name: gate5c_post_ledger_adoption
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) total_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ConexionID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_conexion_id,SUM(CASE WHEN UnidadNegocioID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_unidad_id,SUM(CASE WHEN CodigoSync IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_codigo_sync,SUM(CASE WHEN StartedAtUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_started_utc,SUM(CASE WHEN FinishedAtUTC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_finished_utc,SUM(CASE WHEN IdempotencyKey IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_idempotency_key FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones

queries.name: gate5c_post_recent_universal_runs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 SyncRunID,SyncType,CONVERT(varchar(36),ConexionID) ConexionID,CONVERT(varchar(36),UnidadNegocioID) UnidadNegocioID,CodigoSync,StartedAtUTC,FinishedAtUTC,IdempotencyKey,Status FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE StartedAtUTC IS NOT NULL OR FinishedAtUTC IS NOT NULL OR IdempotencyKey IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SyncControlID DESC

queries.name: gate5c_post_duplicate_idempotency
queries.sql: SELECT IdempotencyKey,COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE IdempotencyKey IS NOT NULL GROUP BY IdempotencyKey HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1

queries.name: gate5c_post_invalid_codigo_sync
queries.sql: SELECT e.CodigoSync,COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones e LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo c ON c.Codigo=e.CodigoSync WHERE e.CodigoSync IS NOT NULL AND c.Codigo IS NULL GROUP BY e.CodigoSync

queries.name: gate5c_post_invalid_connection_refs
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) invalid_connections FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones e LEFT JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones c ON c.id=e.ConexionID WHERE e.ConexionID IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NULL

queries.name: gate5c_post_invalid_unit_refs
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) invalid_units FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones e LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON u.id=e.UnidadNegocioID WHERE e.UnidadNegocioID IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NULL

queries.name: gate5c_post_schema_guard
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.tables WHERE name='Servidores_ConexionEstado') health_table_count,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.tables WHERE name='Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') ledger_table_count,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.tables WHERE name LIKE 'Toast[_]%') toast_domain_tables
